title: New Captain
author: Joshua Kaden
description:
Menu-driven starship mission

You are a last-minute replacement for the retiring Captain Chowder. Spacegroup gave you exactly one day’s notice to prepare for your new rank of Captain, and your new command position on the science starship Athena.

Make decisions and give orders as you see fit. How the officers feel about you may change based on what you do.

Explore the ship. Use the computer and comms. Get to know your officers, and reshuffle them as needed; create a plan with them, and accomplish your mission of diplomacy and science.

Good luck, Captain!
